texts.Is there anything else you'd like to add: I run what this role manages: AI transformation in production, every day. My multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines, MCP connectors, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, published reliability evals) is operated in public - claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate, FAILURE-MODES.md at github.com/tonydzi. Before that: 15+ years as founder/operator - co-founder of Platinum VC & Incubator ($35M under management, 40+ engineers across APAC), Chief Engineer at Everex (Singapore) structuring crypto payments and stablecoins with banks and governments across SE Asia - so I can sit in front of an enterprise customer or a regulator and drive adoption end-to-end. US O-1 visa active, no sponsorship needed; available immediately; SF Bay Area.
